lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of approximately 4-6 high-luminance circular blobs each, positioned in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the gill slits and along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the high-luminance circular blobs to form a visible rectangular grid of anchor nodes across the shark's side.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge running along the upper third of the flank, marked by a sharp vertical gradient from light (dorsal) to shadowed (ventral) pixels.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Small, discrete high-luminance spots distributed across the lateral surface of the visible first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora attached to the dorsal surface of the head/neck region, with additional remoras visible in the ventral water column.
